# Sanatana360 - India's 1st Sacred Heritage Knowledge OTT Platform & Vedic Gurukula

> Sanatana360 (https://www.sanatana360.com) is India's pioneer digital streaming and Gurukula platform dedicated to preserving and celebrating Sanatana Dharma, Indian heritage, Vedic science, 24/7 live temple darshanas, and ancient epics.

## Core Pillars & Knowledge Domains
- **200+ Sacred Sagas & Docu-Series**: Cinematic documentaries covering Ramayana, Mahabharata, Cholas, Vijayanagara Empire, Kashi, Kedarnath, Rani Lakshmibai, and ancient mysteries.
- **Divya Darshana (40+ 24/7 Live Temples)**: Official live 24/7 streaming sanctum darshanas and aartis from Shree Kashi Vishwanath, Tirumala Tirupati Balaji, Shirdi Sai Baba, Somnath Jyotirlinga, Mahakaleshwar Ujjain, Udupi Krishna, and Kedarnath.
- **Granthalaya (26 Illustrated Epics & Granthas)**: Interactive illustrated books, audiobooks, and ancient Sanskrit-English manuscripts.
- **Kids Gurukula**: Animated Panchatantra, Jataka tales, moral values, and interactive Vedic math lessons for children.
- **Vedic Wellness Suite**: Interactive Ayurvedic Dosha Analyzer (Prakriti test), 32 Therapeutic Ragas for stress relief and sleep, and interactive Mudra Studio for yoga healing.
- **Ask Rishi AI**: 24/7 Vedic AI philosophical guide trained on Bhagavad Gita and Upanishads.
